title: Queen of the Beskids
lead: One prominent mountain, diverse landscapes, and the satisfaction of a well-planned day.
body:
Towards the Sky

Babia Góra dominates the surrounding area, drawing those who seek distinct emotions and spectacular views in the mountains. It is a place where the weather changes in the blink of an eye, and nature reminds us of its unpredictability.

Sunrise on Diablak is an experience that stays in memory forever. When the first rays tear through the darkness and a sea of clouds spreads out beneath your feet, you can feel euphoria and peace at the same time. It is the reward for effort and an early wake-up.

Trail of Mindfulness

Slow travel on Babia Góra is primarily about knowing how to stop. Instead of chasing the summit, it is worth appreciating the trail through Markowe Szczawiny, where alpine meadows and crystal-clear streams create the perfect setting for calm.

After descending, it is worth visiting the open-air museum in Zawoja to feel the spirit of old pastoral life and rest in the shade of old trees, remembering that every summit is just a stop on a longer journey toward oneself.
tip: Remember that Babia Góra can be treacherous with weather. Always keep a rain jacket in your backpack, even if the sun is shining in the morning — this will let you enjoy the hike without unnecessary stress.
